title: Baahubali: The Beginning
plot: Shiva, raised by a tribal family at the foot of a giant waterfall, climbs it to discover the kingdom of Mahishmati and his royal lineage as the son of the legendary warrior Amarendra Baahubali.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
plot: The answer to why Kattappa killed Baahubali: the saga of Amarendra Baahubali's betrayal by Bhallaladeva and Mahendra Baahubali's revenge to reclaim the throne of Mahishmati.

title: RRR
plot: A fictional tale of revolutionaries Alluri Sitarama Raju and Komaram Bheem, whose friendship and fight against the British Raj won the Oscar for the song Naatu Naatu.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
plot: Pushpa Raj, a coolie in the red sandalwood smuggling syndicate of Seshachalam forests, rises through the ranks with raw cunning while clashing with the ruthless cop Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
plot: Pushpa Raj expands his red sandalwood empire across borders while his feud with Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat escalates, threatening his family and his rule.

title: Magadheera
plot: A bike racer discovers memories of his past life 400 years ago as Kala Bhairava, a fearless warrior who died protecting a princess, and history begins to repeat itself.

title: Eega
plot: A man murdered by a jealous industrialist is reborn as a housefly and sets out on an ingenious mission of revenge to protect the woman he loves.

title: Arjun Reddy
plot: A brilliant but short-tempered surgeon spirals into self-destruction with alcohol and drugs after his college sweetheart is married off to someone else.

title: Jersey
plot: A failed cricketer in his late thirties returns to the game to fulfil his young son's wish for a jersey, fighting age and circumstance for one last shot at the Indian team.

title: Mahanati
plot: The glorious rise and tragic fall of legendary actress Savitri, the queen of Telugu cinema, told through the eyes of a journalist uncovering her story decades later.

title: Rangasthalam
plot: In the 1980s village of Rangasthalam, a partially deaf motor mechanic Chitti Babu and his brother take on the tyrannical village president in a fight for justice.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
plot: Bantu, belittled by his father all his life, discovers he was swapped at birth and is the true heir of a wealthy family, then wins over the household that is rightfully his.

title: Sita Ramam
plot: An orphan soldier's life changes when he receives letters from a mysterious Sita Mahalakshmi; twenty years later a student must deliver his final letter and uncover their love story.

title: Jathi Ratnalu
plot: Three good-for-nothing friends from Jogipet move to the city for a better life and hilariously land themselves in jail after a series of absurd misadventures.

title: Pokiri
plot: Pandu, a ruthless contract killer working for the Mumbai mafia, hides a stunning secret identity that is revealed in one of Telugu cinema's most iconic twists.

title: Athadu
plot: A professional assassin framed for a politician's murder assumes the identity of a long-lost relative in a village family, only to grow attached to the life he borrowed.

title: Bommarillu
plot: Siddhu, suffocated by his loving but controlling father, falls for the free-spirited Hasini and must convince his family to let him live life on his own terms.

title: Happy Days
plot: Four years of engineering college life: eight friends navigate ragging, romance, heartbreak and farewell in this nostalgic ode to campus days.

title: Nuvvostanante Nenoddantana
plot: A wealthy young man falls for a village girl whose protective brother, scarred by his sister-in-law's betrayal, refuses to marry her into a rich family.

title: Mayabazar
plot: Ghatotkacha uses his magical powers to unite Abhimanyu and Sasirekha in this beloved classic, widely considered the greatest Telugu film ever made.

title: Pathala Bhairavi
plot: A gardener's son who loves a princess must outwit a sinister sorcerer who needs a brave young man to sacrifice to the goddess Pathala Bhairavi.

title: Missamma
plot: Two unemployed graduates pretend to be a married couple to land teaching jobs at a school, leading to a tangle of comic misunderstandings and real romance.

title: Sankarabharanam
plot: A revered Carnatic musician fallen on hard times and a devadasi's daughter share a bond through classical music that society misunderstands but cannot break.

title: Sagara Sangamam
plot: A gifted classical dancer whose dreams are crushed by poverty and alcoholism finds late redemption in mentoring the daughter of the woman he silently loved.

title: Swathi Muthyam
plot: An innocent, autistic man marries a young widow to protect her from her scheming relatives; India's official Oscar entry of 1986.

title: Siva
plot: A college student takes on the campus mafia and its kingpin Bhavani in RGV's debut that redefined action filmmaking in Indian cinema with its iconic cycle-chain scene.

title: Geethanjali
plot: Two terminally ill young people meet in Ooty and choose to celebrate life and love in the time they have left.

title: Aditya 369
plot: India's first time-travel film: a scientist's time machine hurls its passengers to the glorious era of Sri Krishnadevaraya and then to a post-apocalyptic future.

title: Indra
plot: Indrasena Reddy, a benevolent Rayalaseema factionist who sacrificed everything to end violence, lives incognito in Varanasi until his past resurfaces.

title: Okkadu
plot: A Hyderabad kabaddi player rescues a young woman from a powerful Rayalaseema faction leader who is obsessed with marrying her, and hides her in his own home.

title: Murari
plot: A playful heir of a feudal family must confront a generations-old curse of the goddess that claims a life in the family every 48 years.

title: Arya
plot: The carefree Arya declares his love to Geetha, who already loves someone else, and his 'feel my love' philosophy turns the classic love triangle on its head.

title: Gabbar Singh
plot: A maverick cop who renamed himself Gabbar Singh after his favourite Sholay villain takes on land-grabber Siddhappa Naidu in his own eccentric style, famous for the Antakshari scene.

title: Attarintiki Daredi
plot: A billionaire's grandson goes undercover as a driver in his estranged aunt's household to reunite her with his dying grandfather.

title: Srimanthudu
plot: A billionaire heir who feels disconnected from his wealth adopts his father's neglected native village and transforms it, inspiring a real-life village adoption movement.

title: Janatha Garage
plot: An environmental science student in Mumbai is drawn back to his estranged family's garage in Hyderabad, which doubles as a people's court for the oppressed.

title: 1: Nenokkadine
plot: A rock star with a 25% functioning brain hallucinates the killers of parents he cannot prove existed, in this cult psychological thriller ahead of its time.

title: Manam
plot: Three generations of the Akkineni family star in a heartwarming tale of reincarnation where a son plays matchmaker to his reborn parents.

title: Pelli Choopulu
plot: A lazy aspiring chef and an ambitious young woman meet at a botched matchmaking session and end up starting a food truck business together.

title: Fidaa
plot: An NRI medical student falls for Bhanumathi, a fiercely independent village girl from Banswada who refuses to leave her Telangana roots for America.

title: Geetha Govindam
plot: A young lecturer's chance at love goes disastrously wrong when a misunderstanding on an overnight bus makes Geetha believe he is a pervert.

title: Goodachari
plot: A young intelligence agent framed for treason must go rogue to clear his name and uncover the truth about his father's death and a mole in the agency.

title: C/o Kancharapalem
plot: Four love stories across different ages and religions unfold in the working-class Visakhapatnam neighbourhood of Kancharapalem, cast entirely with locals.

title: Awe!
plot: Seemingly disconnected stories of strangers in a restaurant — including a talking fish and a time traveller — converge into one mind-bending psychological twist.

title: Brochevarevarura
plot: Three slacker friends' fake kidnapping plan collides with a real one in this cleverly plotted dark comedy of errors.

title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
plot: A struggling small-town detective in Nellore stumbles onto a case of unclaimed dead bodies that is far bigger and darker than anything he imagined.

title: HIT: The First Case
plot: A cop with PTSD from the Homicide Intervention Team investigates a young woman's disappearance that soon entangles his own girlfriend.

title: Uppena
plot: A fisherman's son loves the daughter of a casteist landlord who will go to brutal lengths to protect his family's honour.

title: Love Story
plot: A Zumba instructor and a software-job aspirant from different castes fall in love in Hyderabad while carrying deep scars from their pasts.

title: Shyam Singha Roy
plot: A young filmmaker accused of plagiarism discovers his story comes from his past life as a revolutionary Bengali writer who loved a devadasi in 1970s Kolkata.

title: DJ Tillu
plot: Tillu, a motormouth DJ from Hyderabad, falls for a mysterious woman who drags him into a murder cover-up he narrates his way out of.

title: Tillu Square
plot: Tillu is back and richer, until another whirlwind romance lands him in an even deadlier mess than the first time.

title: Major
plot: The life of Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, the NSG commando who laid down his life saving hostages during the 26/11 Mumbai attacks at the Taj Hotel.

title: Karthikeya 2
plot: A doctor with a rationalist bent races to find Lord Krishna's ancient anklet from Dwaraka while being hunted by a powerful cabal.

title: Bheemla Nayak
plot: A fierce tribal police officer and an arrogant ex-army havildar lock horns in an escalating battle of egos over a bottle of liquor found in a car.

title: Balagam
plot: A grandfather's death and a crow that refuses to touch the ritual offering force a fractured Telangana family to confront years of estrangement.

title: Dasara
plot: In the coal-mining village of Veerlapally, a meek coal thief is pushed to violent reckoning when village politics around a liquor shop destroy what he loves.

title: Virupaksha
plot: In 1990s Rudravanam, mysterious deaths follow a sealed-off house, and a visitor must uncover the village's dark occult secret before the lockdown ritual ends.

title: Baby
plot: A slum-bred auto driver's childhood romance fractures when his girlfriend enters a glittering college world that pulls her away from him.

title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
plot: Deva, a mercenary in exile, returns to the lawless city-state of Khansaar to honour a childhood promise to his friend Varadha, its embattled heir.

title: Hanu-Man
plot: A small-time thief in the village of Anjanadri gains the powers of Lord Hanuman and must protect a sacred gem from a power-hungry supervillain.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
plot: In a dystopian future ruled from the Complex, the immortal Ashwatthama must protect an unborn child prophesied to be Kalki, the final avatar of Vishnu.

title: Devara: Part 1
plot: In a coastal land of smugglers, the fearsome Devara turns against his own people's crimes and becomes a legend of the red sea; years later his meek son Vara rises.

title: Guntur Kaaram
plot: A Guntur chilli merchant abandoned by his mother in childhood refuses to sign away his claim as her son when her political family demands it.

title: Khaidi No. 150
plot: Chiranjeevi's comeback after a decade: an escaped convict swaps places with his lookalike, an activist fighting a corporate land grab against farmers.

title: Waltair Veerayya
plot: A Vizag fisherman with a smuggler's reputation takes a police mission to Malaysia, hiding a burning personal vendetta tied to his half-brother, a fallen cop.

title: Oohalu Gusagusalade
plot: A TV producer coaches his boss to woo the woman he himself once loved and lost, in this charming Cyrano-esque romantic comedy.

title: Ninnu Kori
plot: A man visits his now-married ex-lover's home in the US to prove her marriage can't be happy, only to learn what love and letting go really mean.

title: Kotha Bangaru Lokam
plot: Two teenagers fall in love at their junior college while their fathers' contrasting worlds threaten to pull them apart.

title: Anand
plot: Roopa, an orphan who calls off her wedding over her self-respect, finds an unlikely companion in her easy-going landlord Anand in this gentle feel-good classic.

title: Godavari
plot: Two strangers nursing rejections meet on a boat cruise down the Godavari river to Bhadrachalam and slowly drift toward each other.

title: Vedam
plot: Five strangers — a cable guy, a prostitute, a weaver, a rock guitarist and an old Muslim man — collide at a hospital during a terrorist attack.

title: Kshana Kshanam
plot: An office-going woman and a small-time thief go on the run together when a gangster believes she holds the key to stolen loot, in RGV's cult road caper.

title: Gharana Mogudu
plot: A factory worker marries his arrogant boss, who weds him only to win a bet, and tames her pride; the first Telugu film to gross ten crores.

title: Yamadonga
plot: A petty thief dies and lands in Yamaloka, where he outsmarts Yama, the god of death himself, and gets a second shot at life.

title: Simhadri
plot: A loyal servant in a Visakhapatnam household hides a ferocious past in Kerala, where the oppressed worship him as Singamalai.

title: Chatrapathi
plot: A Sri Lankan Tamil refugee separated from his mother rises against the dockyard mafia that exploits refugees in Visakhapatnam.

title: Bhadrachalam
plot: A boxer returns to his village and fights for the rights of tribal people while training for one redemptive bout.

title: Ee Nagaraniki Emaindi
plot: Four broke friends stuck in Goa after a bachelor-party fiasco decide to enter a short-film contest and rediscover their abandoned dreams.

title: Court: State vs. A Nobody
plot: A junior lawyer fights to save a 19-year-old boy from a draconian POCSO case weaponised by a powerful, casteist family.
